title: RIBBON WAKE
description: Sixteen broad ink ribbons keep elastic deformation memory instead of breaking into click effects. Drag across the field to comb, fold and shear whole bands; tension, cross-linking, drag, current and memory switch between taut graphic rails, soft coupled cloth-like waves and long-lived flowing folds.

visual_finish.composition: sixteen wide continuous bands span the frame and bend into layered wakes instead of exposing solver points
visual_finish.material_model: matte near-black ink bands on warm stock with restrained rust strain color and a fine paper-like edge highlight
detail_scales: individual band edges and strain highlights
